name: AVA
use: In-house virtual AI agent that acts as an AI partner for Optimum customer service reps, giving guidance and relevant offers; enhanced with Google Gemini.

name: ChatIQ
use: GenAI assistant built with Kensho that helps analysts research companies, industries and sectors with traceable answers.

name: CreditCompanion

name: Spark Assist
use: Internal ChatGPT-like tool connected to company data that all S&P Global employees use, sharing useful prompts called sparks.

name: Aspen Virtual Advisor
use: AI advisor that lets plant users ask plain-language questions to find process bottlenecks or ways to reach operating goals.

name: ARC
use: Proprietary machine-learning tool that recommends which clients talent solutions staff should contact and when, based on decades of customer data.

name: Research Buddy
use: AI agent that helps analysts and portfolio managers research large volumes of public and private documents.

name: MyGate
use: Internal generative AI platform wrapping multiple LLMs, available to about half of TIAA's workforce.

name: Toast IQ
use: Conversational AI assistant for restaurant operators that surfaces insights and carries out tasks like changing menus or editing shifts.

name: AIP Assist
use: LLM-powered support assistant that answers users' natural-language questions to help them navigate and use the Palantir platform.

name: Libre Assist
use: Generative AI feature that predicts how a photographed or described meal will affect a diabetic user's glucose and suggests tweaks, then compares with sensor data.

name: JDI (Jefferies Data Intelligence)
use: In-house conversational research assistant built on Databricks Genie that lets equity analysts query multiple data sources in plain language.

name: Cortex AgentiX

name: Conni

name: GreenLake Intelligence
use: Agentic AI framework that deploys AI agents for FinOps, security, networking and storage across HPE's hybrid cloud, coordinated by a reasoning agent.

name: Health Companion
use: Research project in which specialist AI agents (genomics, radiology, pathology) collaborate on patient data and a supervising agent drafts a care plan for physicians.

name: Hey ARMA
use: AI assistant on handheld devices that gives Ace store associates product details, project tips and recommendations in real time.

name: ChipStack AI Super Agent

name: Missi Six
use: Generative AI digital concierge, built with Google Cloud, that helps guests plan park visits and answers customer questions.

name: Genie Assist
